_comment: Who wrote the built-in books, for the Credits page's Writers card. Every book not listed under a writer here is the default writer's. Wilson Taylor's are the six stories ported from the original game's narratives/originals/ and the variants of Musings of Faulthurst that come from narratives/originals/Faulthurst.txt (indices into its variants[]; scripts/credits/house-credits.py --check fails if one stops matching that file). Counts are generated into src/main/resources/assets/dungeontrain/credits/house_credits.json by that script.
